_comment: Mock content for the Sprint 1 onboarding concepts. Local only — nothing here is fetched. Copy is written to the brand voice: short sentences, active voice, no hedging.

privacy.heading: Before you tell us anything
statements: Nothing you do here is visible to your employer, your network, or another user.
This account is yours. It stays yours regardless of where you work.
We ask for a personal email for that reason, and for no other.

direction.prompt: What would you like to move toward?
direction.hint: A role, a scope, an aspiration or a challenge. A precise title is optional.
examples: I want out of agency life
More influence where I already am
I have hit a ceiling and cannot name the next role
direction.sample: I want to lead a larger marketing organisation, ideally somewhere the brand actually matters to the business.

interpretation.sentence: You want to lead a larger marketing organisation, in a business where marketing carries real weight.

refinement.question: Roughly when?
refinement.hint: A rough answer is enough. It changes what we put first, not whether we start.

refinement.question: Who most needs to see this differently?
refinement.hint: The people whose reading of you would change things.

refinement.question: What is most in the way right now?
refinement.hint: Naming the constraint changes what we recommend first.

options.label: No time to work on it

assumption.statement: Based on your goal of leading a larger marketing organisation, we have started with a concise leadership narrative.
assumption.promise: We can make this more specific later.

plans.name: Increase leadership scope
plans.bestFor: A strong performer seeking promotion or a broader remit.
plans.emphasis: Leadership narrative, executive-ready evidence, key conversations.
plans.rationale: You said you want to lead a larger organisation, so this plan starts with the narrative and the evidence that decision-makers ask for.

plans.name: Build executive presence
plans.bestFor: You need greater visibility and a clearer point of view.
plans.emphasis: Positioning, thought leadership, speaking and podcast pitching.

plans.name: Prepare for a career inflection point
plans.bestFor: A promotion, role change, review, board presentation or negotiation is ahead.

plans.name: Strengthen influence in the current organisation
plans.bestFor: You intend to grow where you are.
plans.emphasis: Strategic communication, executive presence, internal opportunity framing.

plans.name: Explore and clarify a next direction
plans.bestFor: You feel a ceiling but cannot name a role.
plans.emphasis: Direction refinement, transferable narrative, low-risk exploratory actions.

artifact.title: Your leadership narrative
artifact.note: A first draft, already started. Edit anything.

sections.heading: What I do
sections.body: I lead marketing organisations where the brand is a commercial instrument rather than a cost line — building the team, the positioning and the operating rhythm that make demand predictable.

sections.heading: What I am known for
sections.body: Taking marketing functions that are treated as a service desk and turning them into a function the executive team plans around.

sections.heading: What I am building toward
sections.body: A larger organisation, in a business where marketing carries real weight in the strategy — not only in the funnel.

sections.heading: Evidence
sections.body: Add two or three specific results and this section writes itself.

connect.title: Add your LinkedIn metrics
connect.body: Enter them yourself, whenever you like. It sharpens future drafts. It is not needed for anything you have today.

connect.title: Connect a personal website
connect.body: Gives us your own voice to write in. Useful later. It changes nothing about the draft you already have.
